specs.label: Active wizard with no rows shows the prompt-only notice
specs.note: Every local wizard returns get_panel()==[], so the panel renders the "prompt-only wizard — no panel rows" fallback.

specs.label: Stacked wizards show the "stack N" depth badge
specs.note: Pushing two wizards makes depth>1, so the panel head renders the stack-depth badge (WizardPanel §depth).

specs.label: Wizard prompt overlay renders (portalled over the viewport)
specs.note: get_prompt() lines render through a portal into .shell__viewport as the green wizard prompt overlay.

specs.label: Clearing the stack hides panel + prompt
specs.note: With depth==0 the panel returns null and the prompt (promptMode 0/empty) is suppressed.

specs.label: Dismiss button pops the active wizard
specs.note: The Dismiss button (shown only while active) calls wizards.dismiss → pops the top wizard; a single-wizard stack empties and the panel disappears.

specs.label: Pick-seam selection input (WizardEventBridge)
specs.note: The pick seam mounts only when event_mask has pick/select bits; the local engine never sets them.

specs.label: do_pick button (WizardEventBridge)
specs.note: Sends wizards.event("pick",{selection}). Requires event_mask_pick, absent in local mode.

specs.label: do_pick(bond) button (WizardEventBridge)
specs.note: Sends wizards.event("pick",{selection,bond:true}). Requires event_mask_pick.

specs.label: do_select button (WizardEventBridge)
specs.note: Sends wizards.event("select",{name}). Requires event_mask_select.

specs.label: Keyboard capture input (WizardKeyCapture do_key)
specs.note: The hidden key-capture input mounts only when event_mask_key is set (line-editor wizards). Local engine reports eventMask 0.

specs.label: Type-2 panel button row fires code on release
specs.note: get_panel() button rows exist only behind the bridge; the local snapshot panel is always [].

specs.label: Type-3 popup row opens get_menu() on press
specs.note: Popup rows call onMenu(code) → wizards.menu; reachable only with a bridge-supplied panel.

specs.label: Wizard popup menu leaf runs its command
specs.note: WizardPopupMenu leaves call onPick(command) → wizards.exec. Requires a popup row to open the menu first.

specs.label: Wizard popup submenu expands on hover/click
specs.note: Nested get_menu submenus (measurement.py neighbour lists) expand via .wizmenu__item--sub.

specs.label: Escape closes the wizard popup menu
specs.note: WizardPopupMenu closes on Escape / outside click. Requires an open popup, which needs a bridge panel row.

specs.label: Measurement mode popup menu (get_menu ported locally)
specs.note: The local engine DOES serve wizards.menu for measurement (mode/object_mode), but no panel row exists to open it in local mode.

specs.label: Type-1 text row renders flat label
specs.note: get_panel() text rows render via .wizrow--text; local panel is always empty.

specs.label: Type-0 blank row occupies a control-size gap
specs.note: get_panel() blank rows render an empty .wizrow--blank spacer; local panel is always empty.
